_readme: Which capture session goes to which split. This file is the split, not
Roboflow's random assignment: near-identical frames from one session land
on both sides of a random split, which inflates mAP and hides the
generalization failure the test set exists to catch.
Hold back a whole lighting condition rather than skimming frames off each
one. Values: train | valid | test. null means undecided — the upload
script refuses to touch a session until someone has chosen.
Keep this in sync with the session table in DATASET_CARD.md.
